base-misc.justification: Essential base package with no Debian fix (affected/deferred/will-not-fix). Affected paths (setuid ACL helpers, Perl Archive::Tar, systemd-homed, gzip CLI, minizip) are not invoked on untrusted input; systemd is not running inside the containers and libsystemd0 is only linked for journald/sd-bus client helpers.

bundled-runtime.justification: Backend Chromium is Playwright 1.64.0's pinned build (156.0.8078.4); 1.64.0 is the newest Playwright and the version is owned by uv.lock (dependency lane). Hosted browser tasks run in the sandbox image, which ships stable 156.0.8078.47; the backend binary is used only by native/REPL mode, which must not browse untrusted sites in hosted deployments. Remove when Playwright ships a 156 stable-or-newer build.

cups.justification: Chromium links libcups for print dialogs; Debian lists these unfixed. The CVEs need a malicious CUPS/IPP server or shared queue: no cupsd runs, no printer is configured, and sandbox egress is policy-restricted.

ncurses.justification: Essential terminal library from the base image; Debian lists it unfixed. No untrusted terminfo or terminal input is processed: services are non-interactive and never attach a TTY to remote parties.

util-linux.justification: Essential Debian base package from the official python slim image; Debian lists it unfixed. Affected code is mount/nsenter/login/lastlog administration paths. Images never mount untrusted filesystems or offer logins; network-facing processes run as non-root (backend uid 10001; sandbox Chromium/socat/Xvfb as sandboxuser) in containers started with no-new-privileges and without CAP_SYS_ADMIN (backend additionally cap_drop ALL).

xclient.justification: X11 client library with no Debian fix. Malicious input must come from the X server, which is the container-local Xvfb under the same uid; web content never speaks the X protocol.

xml-tiff-glib.justification: Unfixed in Debian. Chromium for Testing does not link this system library (verified with ldd; it bundles its own libxml/SQLite/HarfBuzz/expat and web image decoders). Installed only as a dependency of local trusted-data consumers (Mesa libllvm, shared-mime-info, gdk-pixbuf, fontconfig); no untrusted documents reach it.

xserver.justification: Debian lists these X server CVEs unfixed. Exploitation needs a malicious X client. Sandbox: Xvfb listens only on its local unix socket (-nolisten tcp) in a per-task container and its only client is the same-uid Chromium, so this is post-browser-compromise only. Backend: installed by `playwright install --with-deps` but never started (Chromium launches headless).

accepted_runtime.justification: Backend Chromium is Playwright 1.64.0's pinned build (156.0.8078.4); 1.64.0 is the newest Playwright and the version is owned by uv.lock (dependency lane). Hosted browser tasks run in the sandbox image, which ships stable 156.0.8078.47; the backend binary is used only by native/REPL mode, which must not browse untrusted sites in hosted deployments. Remove when Playwright ships a 156 stable-or-newer build.
accepted_runtime.title: Bundled Chromium is older than current Linux stable 156.0.8078.47

accepted_runtime.justification: Node 24.21.0 is the driver bundled inside the uv.lock-pinned Playwright 1.64.0 wheel; it only speaks to the parent Python process over stdio pipes and never parses network input itself. Fixed by a Playwright upgrade owned by the dependency lane; /usr/local/bin/node (agent host) is on 22.23.4, the latest security release.
